_comment: Names and words she will never say out loud. Matched against the FOLDED form (orchestrator/sanitize.py): NFKD, accents stripped, homoglyphs and leet mapped, separators dropped, runs collapsed. One entry therefore covers n_i_g, n1g, nі99er and the Cyrillic lookalikes without listing them.
_substrings: Disqualifying wherever they appear, however padded. ONLY put terms here that cannot occur inside an innocent word — the fold has no separators left, so 'rape' here would also block 'grapes' and 'cunt' would block 'Scunthorpe'. When unsure, use words.
_words: Matched as whole words against the raw text, so a name that merely contains one survives. Everything with an innocent superstring belongs here.
_note: A seed list, not a finished one. Add what your chat actually produces. Every intervention is counted — watch the [sanitize] tally: a term slipping through shows up as a message read that should not have been, and a false positive shows up as a name you know is fine getting a placeholder.
